info.name: HomeNest PG Management API
info.description:
# HomeNest PG Management API

Import this file in Postman with **File → Import**. No environment file is required. Collection variables are pre-configured.

## Quick Start
1. Set `baseUrl` if the server is not on `http://localhost:5000`.
2. Run **02 Authentication → Login** (defaults to `admin@example.com` / `Admin@123`).
3. The test script automatically captures `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId`, and `pgId` into collection variables.
4. Protected requests automatically reuse `{{accessToken}}` as a Bearer token.

Default Seed Accounts (Password: `Admin@123456` or `Admin@123`):
- **PG Owner (Admin)**: `admin@example.com`
- **Resident (Tenant)**: `resident@example.com`
- **Super Administrator**: `superadmin@example.com`

## Base URL
Use `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/...`.

## Auth & PG Scoping
- Public routes (Health, Login, OTP, Forgot/Reset Password, Owner Registration) do not require a token.
- Protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
- The access token encodes `{ id, email, role, pg_id }`.
- For all APIs (Rooms, Agreements, Residents), `pg_id` is automatically resolved from the token. Passing `pg_id` in request bodies or query params is completely optional.

## Response Envelope
Every response adheres to the standardized contract:

**Query / Read Endpoints (GET)**:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {}, "meta": {} }
```

**Mutation Endpoints (POST / PUT / DELETE)**:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "id": 12 }
```

**Action Endpoints (Logout / Password Reset)**:
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "..." }
```

## Media & File Uploads
- Image-related POST and PUT endpoints accept `multipart/form-data`.
- Files are completely optional. Allowed formats: JPEG, PNG, JPG, WebP. Max size: 5MB per file.
- Photos are stored locally in `uploads/rooms/` and `uploads/users/`. Responses dynamically return full URLs.

variable.description: API server origin without trailing slash. Default is http://localhost:5000.
JWT access token. Login and auth APIs save data.access_token here. Sent as Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}.
JWT refresh token from data.refresh_token. Sent in the refresh request body. Also set in HTTP-only cookies.
PG facility / branch ID. Resolved automatically from the access token.
Room ID. Saved from Create Room or List Rooms response.
User ID. Saved from Login, Create User, or List Users.
Agreement record ID. Saved from Create Agreement response.
Resident stay ID. Saved from Get My Stays response.
Cryptographic password reset token extracted from the email link or forgot password response.

item.name: 01 Health
item.description: Public service health and system heartbeat endpoints.

request.description:
### GET /
Public. Root welcome heartbeat endpoint to confirm the server is running.

**Response `data`**
| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | Welcome message |
| `version` | string | API version |
| `documentation` | string | Health check URL |

### GET /api/v1/health
Public. System uptime, server status, and timestamp.

**Response `data`**
| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | System status (`UP`) |
| `uptime` | number | Process uptime in seconds |
| `timestamp` | string | Current server ISO timestamp |

request.description:
### POST /api/v1/auth/register-pg
Public. Atomically creates an owner account (`role: admin`) and registers their initial PG facility in a single database transaction.
Supports `multipart/form-data` with optional owner profile photo and PG brand logo.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Owner full legal name (2-100 chars) |
| `email` | string | Yes | Unique login email |
| `password` | string | Yes | Account password (min 6 chars) |
| `phone` | string | Yes | 10-digit Indian mobile number |
| `gender` | string | No | `male`, `female`, or `other` |
| `address` | string | No | Owner residential address |
| `profile_photo` | file | No | Optional owner profile photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) |
| `pg_name` | string | Yes | Commercial name of the PG branch |
| `pg_type` | string | No | `boys`, `girls`, `coed`, or `other` (Default: `coed`) |
| `pg_phone` | string | No | Front desk phone number |
| `pg_email` | string | No | Facility contact email |
| `pg_address` | string | Yes | Physical street address |
| `pg_city` | string | Yes | City location |
| `pg_state` | string | Yes | State location |
| `pg_pincode` | string | Yes | 6-digit Indian PIN code |
| `total_rooms` | integer | No | Initial room capacity |
| `total_beds` | integer | No | Initial bed capacity |
| `amenities` | array/string | No | Available amenities (e.g. ["WiFi","AC"]) |
| `rules` | string | No | Facility house rules |
| `logo` | file | No | Optional PG branch brand logo image |

### POST /api/v1/auth/login
Public. Authenticates with email and password. Encodes `pg_id` in the JWT and sets HTTP-only security cookies.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | Yes | Account email address |
| `password` | string | Yes | Account password |

**Response `data`**
| Key | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | string | JWT access token with encoded `pg_id` |
| `refresh_token` | string | Long-lived refresh token |
| `user` | object | Authenticated user profile |

### POST /api/v1/auth/send-otp
Public. Dispatches a 6-digit OTP to a registered mobile number. Stored in Redis with a 5-minute TTL.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone` | string | Yes | 10-digit Indian mobile number |

### POST /api/v1/auth/verify-otp
Public. Verifies the OTP and issues access/refresh tokens with embedded `pg_id`.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone` | string | Yes | 10-digit Indian mobile number |
| `otp` | string | Yes | 6-digit verification code |

### POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password
Public. Generates a 32-byte cryptographic token, saves it in Redis (15m TTL), and queues a branded email containing a redirect link to `reset-password?token={reset_token}`.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | Yes | Registered account email address |

### POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password
Public. Validates the reset token from Redis, hashes the new password, and invalidates the token.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | string | Yes | Token from email link or collection variable |
| `password` | string | Yes | New replacement password (min 6 chars) |

### POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Public. Rotates the expired access token using the valid refresh token (from body or HTTP-only cookie).

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refresh_token` | string | Yes | Refresh token string |

### POST /api/v1/auth/logout
Clears session cookies and terminates the active session.

### GET /api/v1/auth/me
Protected. Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile and active stay info.

### POST /api/v1/buildings
Private (Admin / Super Admin). Create a new building under a PG facility. Automatically captures `buildingId`.

item.name: 05 Room Management
item.description: Room inventory, occupancy metrics, floor plan allocations, and room media uploads.

request.description:
### GET /api/v1/rooms/stats
Protected. Returns KPI metrics cards: Total Rooms, Occupied, Vacant, Maintenance, and Out of Service. Automatically scoped by token's `pg_id`.

### GET /api/v1/rooms/buildings
Protected. Returns list of distinct room building names and their floor arrays for the PG facility.

Required. Room classification: single, double, triple, deluxe, etc.

Optional. Maximum resident bed capacity (Default: 1).
Optional. Room physical dimensions (e.g. 14 m*2).

Optional file. Room photograph. JPEG, PNG, JPG, WebP. Max 5MB.

request.description:
### POST /api/v1/rooms
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Creates a new room using `multipart/form-data`. `image` file is completely optional. If `pg_id` is omitted, it defaults from `access_token`.

query.description: Optional. Filter rooms by building ID.

request.description:

Protected. Paginated room inventory with joined current occupant names and dynamic room image URLs. Scoped automatically to the token's `pg_id`.

request.description:
### PUT /api/v1/rooms/:id
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Updates room information or toggles maintenance status. Supports optional image replacement via `multipart/form-data`.

### DELETE /api/v1/rooms/:id
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Soft-deletes a vacant room. Rejects deletion if active residents are currently assigned.

request.description:
### POST /api/v1/users
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Matches the **Create New Resident** screen. Automatically generates a secure random password if omitted, stores its bcrypt hash, and dispatches a branded welcome email containing login credentials (email & password) and stay/facility details to the resident. If `role: resident` and `room_id` is passed, atomically creates the active stay record in `resident_pg_stays` and sets room status to `occupied`.

request.description:
### PUT /api/v1/users/profile
Protected (Any authenticated user). Updates the user profile.

**Role-Based Validation Behavior:**
- **Role `resident`**: Validates all onboarding data submitted together according to the UI (Personal Details, Address & Emergency Contact, Document Uploads, Agreement & Digital Signature).
- **Role `admin` / `super_admin`**: All fields remain completely optional, allowing property owners and administrators to update individual profile fields without requiring resident-specific onboarding documents.

### GET /api/v1/users/:id
Protected (Any authenticated user). Retrieves comprehensive resident/user details matching the Admin Resident Profile portal:
- **Overview**: Personal info (name, DOB, calculated age, gender, nationality, marital status, occupation)
- **Room Information**: Room number, room type, capacity, building name, floor number/name, bed number, monthly rent, security deposit, check-in date, expected check-out, current status
- **Contact Information**: Phone, email, emergency contact person & relationship, emergency phone, residential address, city, state, pincode, location display
- **Documents**: URLs and filenames for Aadhar card, passport size photo, address proof, education certificate, digital signature, and terms & conditions agreement timestamp
- **Agreements & Stays**: Complete history of tenancy agreements and stays across PG facilities.

request.description:
### PUT /api/v1/users/:id
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Allows administrators to update any user or resident record by ID.
Supports updating personal details, address, emergency contact, stay/room allocation, status, and document uploads via `multipart/form-data` or JSON.

### DELETE /api/v1/users/:id
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Soft-deletes user account. If resident, automatically vacates their room and cascades soft deletion to stays.

item.name: 07 Resident Stays
item.description: Resident stay timeline across multiple PGs and check-out management.

query.description: Optional. Filter stays by specific PG ID.
Optional. Search room number, PG name, city.

request.description:
### GET /api/v1/stays/my-history
Protected (Resident). Returns all stays in a clean paginated list with boolean `is_current_stay: true / false` on each record.

### GET /api/v1/stays/:id
Protected. Retrieves detailed stay record including PG, room, rent, deposit, and check-in timeline.

### PUT /api/v1/stays/:id/vacate
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Checks out resident from PG. Marks stay as `completed` and resets room status to `vacant` if no remaining active occupants.

item.name: 08 Agreements
item.description: Tenancy agreements lifecycle tracking (draft, pending, signed, expired).

query.description: Optional. Filter agreement statistics by PG facility branch ID.
Optional. Filter agreement statistics by agreement type (e.g. 'rental', '11_months').

request.description:
### GET /api/v1/agreements/stats
Protected. Returns top KPI statistical counts for agreements matching the dashboard cards: Total Agreements (`total_agreements`), `draft`, `pending_sign`, `signed`, and `expired`. Supports optional branch (`pg_id`) and `agreement_type` filtering.

### POST /api/v1/agreements
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Matches the **Create New Agreement** portal screen. If `pg_id` is omitted, defaults automatically from `access_token`.

**Body keys**
| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resident_id` | integer | Yes | Resident user account ID |
| `agreement_no` | string | Yes | Unique agreement reference number |
| `room_id` | integer | No | Physical room ID |
| `room_type` | string | No | Single, double, etc. Auto-resolved from room if omitted |
| `agreement_type` | string | No | Tenancy duration (e.g. 11_months, monthly) |
| `start_date` | string | No | Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `end_date` | string | No | End date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `status` | string | No | `signed`, `pending`, `draft`, `expired` (Default: draft) |
| `pg_id` | integer | No | Defaults automatically from access_token |

query.description: Optional. Search agreement number or resident name.
Optional. Filter by specific resident user ID.

request.description:
### GET /api/v1/agreements
Protected. Paginated agreement records directory with joined resident and room details. Scoped automatically to the token's `pg_id`.

### GET /api/v1/agreements/:id
Protected. Retrieves agreement record with resident and room information.

### PUT /api/v1/agreements/:id
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Updates agreement status or tenancy duration details.

### DELETE /api/v1/agreements/:id
Protected (Admin / Super Admin). Soft-deletes an agreement record.
